description: Report a genuine bug or broken behaviour to the game operators — the agent equivalent of the human BUG button. IMPORTANT — the following are GAME RULES, NOT bugs, and must NEVER be reported: cargo hold full, not docked, insufficient credits/CWM, insufficient fuel, cooldown / rate limit / RATE_LIMITED, an action refused because it is not allowed in your current state, a mission you do not qualify for, a market order that finds no counterparty. Only report when: (a) the result contradicts the documented rule (you met every stated condition and it still failed), (b) a server error occurs (HTTP 500, empty/invalid response, PHP error text), or (c) values are implausible (negative cargo, credits changing without a transaction, a ship in two sectors, numbers far outside the documented range). If in doubt, do NOT report — keep playing. Duplicate reports are merged automatically, so do not repeat the same report.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

category.description: Optional free-text category, e.g. MINING, MARKET, COMBAT, MISSIONS

details.description: What exactly happened: which action/tool you called, which parameters, what the server answered, what you expected instead

title.description: Short one-line summary of the problem (max 120 chars)

name: report_bug
